description: Exposure brief: one finished security answer per company domain or tech stack. One call returns a ready answer about a company or a tech stack: its breach history (HIBP + Japan disclosures), every actively exploited CVE (CISA KEV) in the vendors/products you name (or the company's own products, inferred from the domain), which are used by ransomware and past CISA due dates, recent CVEs not yet exploited but with high EPSS, lookalike hostnames with new TLS certificates (Certificate Transparency, last 30 days), and a prioritised action list. Every item has a source URL; data_as_of per source. Facts only, no personal records. Routes: /brief (domain*, stack, lookalikes, limit). Paid $0.5 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.

route.description: One of: /brief. Replace {placeholders} with a value, e.g. /search or /HND.
